_comment: Cue name -> exact spoken phrase (a verbatim, unique run of transcript.json tokens). Resolve with: python ../../tools/word_anchors.py transcript.json --spec anchors.json -o anchors.js --lead-in 3.0 (3.0s = the silent 01-bumper lead-in before the VO starts). Phrases are the words the visual is ABOUT, never an estimated offset. Names are camelCase so scenes can reference them as W.<name>.
